problem.author: Jeffrey Shallit
problem.problem: Problem 11: whether the Thue-Morse word is prime under finite-state transduction
problem.coverage: The source lane read the exact convention and found no Problem 11 resolution update on this author page; this is not an exhaustive current-status assessment.

primary_model.title: The Degree of Squares is an Atom (Extended Version)
primary_model.convention: Complete pure sequential deterministic binary transducers may emit arbitrary finite words, including the empty word. Degrees concern infinite streams.
primary_model.prior_example: The paper gives mutual transducibility of Thue-Morse and the period-doubling stream; no new equivalence is claimed here.

source_scope.finite_family: All 256 labelled two-state complete binary letter-to-letter transducers, initial state 0, no initial output. Unreachable states remain part of the table encoding.
source_scope.classification: Equality of entire infinite output streams, including initial symbols; not finite-prefix agreement or transduction-degree equivalence.
source_scope.boundary: No classification of ultimate periodicity, arbitrary variable-output transductions or primeness; no novelty, prize or external-frontier claim.

adjacent_difference_machine.output: y(0)=0; y(n)=T(n-1) xor T(n) for n>=1; equivalently 0 followed by the prior period-doubling stream

query_compact_totals.interpretation: Compact exact forms of this one retained query, not formulas asserted for arbitrary bounds.

snapshot.model: complete binary letter-to-letter deterministic transducers; no initial output

encoding.transition_code: f0 + M*f1, where M=q^q and fa is the base-q code of delta(state,a)
encoding.kernel_state: [F0,F1,G0,G1,parity]; binary index digits read least significant first
encoding.class_order: increasing first machine code; members in increasing machine code
encoding.minimal_dfa_order: BFS from root, digit 0 before digit 1

premise.use: The integer 19 only selects a new query index; no relationship between lattice packings and transduction is asserted.

result.interpretation: equality of infinite output streams; not transduction-degree equivalence

result.certificate: same certified canonical minimal output DFA

result.witness_order: shortest digit word, then lexicographic LSB-digit order; not minimum numeric index

retained_consumer.scope: Complete finite-family stream equality with exact infinite automata; no transduction-degree or general primeness assertion.

execution_coverage.source_only_branches: One-state compilation, lower kernel caps, oversized/corrupt data, difference-cap exceptions and unrelated query inputs will remain source-inspected.
execution_coverage.timings: Single connected V8 observations, not a statistical benchmark.
execution_coverage.prefix_query_custody: Complete response and final digit-DP state counts are retained; intermediate digit-DP layers are not retained or represented as stored.
